text.text: The Pokémon Mini was released in 2001 as a small handheld system designed around Pokémon-themed games. It featured a monochrome screen, vibration support, a built-in clock, and an infrared communication system for connecting with other units. The system had a small library including Pokémon Party Mini, Pokémon Pinball Mini, and Pokémon Puzzle Collection. Its compact design made it one of Nintendo's smallest gaming systems, although limited software support prevented widespread success. Today it is known as one of the rarest Nintendo handheld platforms.
